summary: AFM Services is a Norwood, SA accounting, bookkeeping and advisory firm founded by John Zerella in 1995, with around 47 staff per a 2026 case study and a recent move from MYOB to Xero. It advertised for an experienced bookkeeper in August-September 2026, and John positions himself as an NDIS tax specialist.

claims.text: AFM Services is a Norwood, South Australia accounting, bookkeeping and advisory firm for small to medium businesses.

claims.text: The bookkeeper role includes reconciling bank and credit card accounts, BAS and GST support, and payroll, using Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks.

claims.text: AFM offers bookkeeping, accounting, taxation, business advisory including due diligence, payroll and wealth creation.
Dom Zerella is Associate Director and Head of Accounting at AFM and shares the firm's hiring posts.
claims.quote: AFM is looking for an experienced Bookkeeper. If this is you, or someone you know, please feel free to reach out.

hooks.text: Hiring an experienced bookkeeper whose duties include bank and credit card reconciliations - reconciliation load is real and growing the team
John's NDIS tax work stresses 'tested and explainable', which matches Vert's traceable approach
Moved from MYOB to Xero in the cloud with ~47 staff - open to modernising systems

gaps: No Facebook/Instagram posts checked in detail
